voice: espeak-ng + MBROLA us2, rate 158, pitch 32, word gap 3 ("Us." and the last line: rate 110, pitch 26)

lines.text: Three hundred metres down, something behind you sounds exactly like you.
lines.beat_before: hook: the waterfall display, a second trace astern

lines.text: Day nine. I am on sonar. A contact. Directly behind us.
lines.beat_before: the submarine in black water; the red sonar room

lines.text: No match. So I compare it to the only thing left.

lines.beat_before: the two signatures, side by side

lines.text: Same propeller. Same rattle from the loose panel we never fixed.
lines.beat_before: the signatures match; the panel rattles
the telegraph to ALL STOP; the crew frozen
the trace on the display stops

lines.text: Then, through the hull, we all hear it.
Three slow knocks. The way our cook knocks on the galley hatch.
Our cook is standing right next to me.
lines.beat_before: the operator turns: the cook, right there

lines.text: When we surface, nothing is behind us. Only a long scrape down the stern.
lines.beat_before: dawn; walking aft along the hull
